title: Lost in the woods? Stay put and make yourself big 🌲
caption:
3 rules that get people found 🧭
Save this before your next hike 👇
sources: US National Park Service / USDA Forest Service hiker safety guidance: 'STOP' (Stop, Think, Observe, Plan); stay put if lost
'Hug-a-Tree and Survive' programme (Jacob, 1981; National Association for Search and Rescue) (stay in one place, make yourself big and visible)
Mountain Rescue (England & Wales) / international distress signal: six whistle blasts per minute in Europe; three blasts widely taught in North America
